title: Pseudo-coherent complexes on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use its equivalent small affine etale ringed model and its unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. An object $K$ is pseudo-coherent if it is represented by a cochain complex $P$ of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] such that for every object $V$ of the small etale model there is a covering sieve $T$ of $V$ and, for every $f:U\to V$ in $T$, a complex $F$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules, an integer $b$, and a quasi-isomorphism $F\to P|_U$, with $F^n=0$ for $n>b$ and $F^n\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r_n}$ for finite integers $r_n\ge0$. The covering and upper bound may vary with the object; ranks may vary with the degree. This is the etale-local bounded-above finite-free characterization of pseudo-coherence on algebraic spaces.
